summary: Completed testing of FOUNDERS50 promo code implementation. Fixed critical bug where frontend was missing /api prefix in payment API calls. All backend Stripe payment APIs working correctly (13/13 tests passed). Frontend checkout flow now successfully redirects to Stripe with promo code input field visible.

minor.issue: Returns 520 (via proxy) for invalid plan instead of 400 - edge case, not blocking

fixed_bugs.issue: API calls missing /api prefix - caused 404 errors when clicking checkout buttons

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/payments/plans returns monthly ($4.99) and yearly ($39.99) plans
Backend: POST /api/payments/create-checkout creates valid Stripe checkout sessions
Backend: POST /api/payments/setup-promo-codes - FOUNDERS50 promo code exists in Stripe
Backend: Checkout sessions have allow_promotion_codes=True enabled
Frontend: Upgrade page displays correctly with pricing and features
Frontend: Monthly/Yearly buttons have correct data-testid attributes
Frontend: Promo code hint text visible on upgrade page
Frontend: Clicking plan buttons redirects to Stripe Checkout
Frontend: Stripe Checkout shows 'Add promotion code' link for entering FOUNDERS50
seed_data_creation: None required - uses live Stripe API
test_credentials: No auth required for payment flow
